serverPerformance.scope: Thirty production-rate seconds per case, authoritative simulation and relevance snapshots with hard bots; not forty browser clients.
serverPerformance.metricsNote: Default Vitest reporter suppresses successful per-case console output; all five unchanged performance tests are included in the passing full suite.

live.scope: Active production player/camera walkthrough in an isolated local match. One initial authoritative fixture placement, then trusted browser mouse/keyboard only. Not human gameplay acceptance.

cleanup.scope: Two complete production world assemblies; each reachable instance batch, geometry, material and mapped texture releases exactly once despite repeated dispose calls.
cleanup.limitations: No WebGL allocation/memory measurement, live match, audio, sockets, players or Classic scene. Global borrowed Sprite geometry is retained. Does not prove every unreachable library resource is freed.

staticViews.scope: Static actual-world assembly, no player/HUD/sky/bloom/shadows; not FPS or human acceptance.

limitations: Mall grade joins and raised-deck boundaries remain angular; no unsupported visual pavement was added.
